userStories.title: Inventory the existing LEAP application
userStories.description: Perform a comprehensive read-only audit of the existing LEAP codebase before making major changes. Identify the application architecture, routes/pages, reusable UI components, API routes, external API integrations, authentication, database access, AI integrations, video/content systems, LaTeX rendering, and critical user flows. Produce documentation that future stories can use as the authoritative map of the application.
acceptanceCriteria: All major application routes/pages are identified and documented
All API routes and server-side integrations are identified
All external APIs/services are identified
Authentication and authorization flow is documented
Database and persistence layer are documented
AI integrations are documented
Course creation and learning flows are documented
Current LaTeX rendering implementation is identified
Important reusable UI components are identified
Critical user journeys are documented
No application functionality is removed during this discovery story
Documentation is committed to the repository

userStories.title: Inventory and verify every API integration
userStories.description: Test every API and external integration discovered during the application audit. Determine whether each integration works, fails, is deprecated, is unused, requires configuration, or needs replacement. Do not remove an integration merely because it is old or unfamiliar.
acceptanceCriteria: Every discovered API/integration has been tested where technically possible
Each API is classified as working, broken, deprecated, unused, configuration-dependent, or requiring replacement
HTTP/API responses and relevant failure reasons are recorded
Authentication and environment-variable requirements are documented without exposing secret values
API failures are investigated rather than silently ignored
Required broken APIs are identified for later repair
No existing API is silently deleted or replaced during the audit
An API audit document is created and committed

userStories.title: Fix required API and integration failures
userStories.description: Repair or replace API integrations that are required for the application and were identified as broken during the API audit. Preserve behavior where possible and document any unavoidable changes.
acceptanceCriteria: All critical broken integrations identified in the audit are repaired or replaced
Required API authentication/configuration works
Relevant application flows using the repaired integrations work
Deprecated integrations that require replacement are migrated where necessary
Unused integrations are not unnecessarily reintroduced
API audit documentation is updated with final status
Tests or verification evidence exist for repaired integrations
No secrets are committed

userStories.title: Establish the LEAP design system
userStories.description: Create a consistent modern visual foundation for the entire application before performing the full UI redesign. Audit existing styling and establish reusable patterns for typography, spacing, colors, buttons, forms, cards, navigation, dialogs, loading states, errors, empty states, and responsive behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: A consistent design system is established
Existing duplicated styling patterns are consolidated where practical
Typography is consistent
Spacing and layout conventions are consistent
Buttons and interactive controls are consistent
Forms and inputs are consistent
Cards and content containers are consistent
Loading, empty, and error states have reusable patterns
The design system supports responsive layouts
Existing functionality remains usable

userStories.title: UI redesign pass 1 - information architecture
userStories.description: Perform the first complete UI/UX redesign pass across the application. Focus on information architecture, navigation, page hierarchy, layout structure, dashboard organization, and separation between course creation and course learning experiences.
acceptanceCriteria: Every major application page is reviewed
Navigation is coherent
Page hierarchy is clear
Course maker and learning experiences have clear information architecture
Dashboard structure is improved
Major user journeys have logical navigation
No major page is left with the old structure without justification
Changes are implemented rather than merely documented

userStories.title: UI redesign pass 2 - visual system
userStories.description: Perform the second complete UI/UX pass focused on visual quality and consistency across the entire application.
acceptanceCriteria: Every major page is visually reviewed
Typography is consistently applied
Spacing is consistent
Color usage is consistent
Cards, buttons, forms, dialogs, and navigation share a coherent visual language
Visual hierarchy is improved
Obvious legacy styling is removed or modernized
The application presents as one cohesive product

userStories.title: Redesign the course maker experience
userStories.description: Rework the complete course creation and course management experience into a modern course-authoring interface.
acceptanceCriteria: Course creation flow is redesigned
Course dashboard/management is redesigned
Module management is redesigned
Subtopic management is redesigned
Course editing is redesigned
Video/content attachment flows are redesigned
AI course generation experience is redesigned
Preview experience is redesigned
Loading and generation states are handled clearly
Error states are handled clearly
Existing course-maker functionality remains operational

userStories.title: Redesign the learning and study experience
userStories.description: Rework the complete learner-facing experience into a modern course studying platform focused on content consumption, video watching, navigation, and progress.
acceptanceCriteria: Course overview is redesigned
Module and lesson navigation is redesigned
Study content viewer is redesigned
Video watching experience is redesigned
Lesson navigation is intuitive
Progress indicators are clear
Completion states are clear
Learning content is readable and well structured
Responsive learning experience works on smaller screens
Existing learning functionality remains operational

userStories.title: Fix and verify the LaTeX renderer
userStories.description: Investigate the existing LaTeX/math rendering implementation, identify the root cause of rendering problems, repair it, and verify mathematical content throughout the application.
acceptanceCriteria: Current LaTeX rendering implementation is understood
Root cause of rendering failures is identified
LaTeX renderer is repaired
Inline mathematical expressions render correctly
Block mathematical expressions render correctly
Complex mathematical expressions are tested
Generated study content containing LaTeX renders correctly
Rendering works across all relevant learning/content pages
Malformed or unsupported expressions fail gracefully
LaTeX verification is documented

userStories.title: UI redesign pass 3 - course creation and editing
userStories.description: Perform another complete UI audit with special emphasis on every course creation, editing, generation, and management screen.
acceptanceCriteria: All course-maker pages are reviewed again
Course creation UX is improved where weaknesses remain
Course editing UX is improved where weaknesses remain
Module/subtopic interactions are improved
AI generation states are improved
Content attachment interactions are improved
Empty and error states are improved
The complete course-maker experience is visually consistent

userStories.title: UI redesign pass 4 - learning and content consumption
userStories.description: Perform another complete UI audit with special emphasis on studying, watching, reading, navigating lessons, and consuming generated educational content.
acceptanceCriteria: All learner-facing pages are reviewed again
Lesson reading experience is improved
Video experience is improved
Study content hierarchy is improved
LaTeX content integrates naturally with the design
Lesson navigation is improved
Progress feedback is improved

userStories.title: UI redesign pass 5 - full application polish
userStories.description: Perform the fifth complete UI/UX audit across the entire application. This is a genuine final redesign and polish pass, not a superficial pass-count requirement.
acceptanceCriteria: Every major application page is reviewed again
Responsive behavior is reviewed
Mobile layouts are reviewed
Loading states are reviewed
Empty states are reviewed
Error states are reviewed
Accessibility issues visible during the audit are addressed
Interaction and animation quality is reviewed
Visual inconsistencies are corrected
Obvious UX friction is corrected
The complete application presents as one polished product
The five UI passes represent substantive rework and improvement

userStories.title: Establish end-to-end application testing
userStories.description: Establish or improve automated end-to-end testing for the critical LEAP user journeys. Use the project's existing testing infrastructure when appropriate and introduce suitable tooling only when necessary.
acceptanceCriteria: Critical user journeys have automated or repeatable E2E verification
Authentication flow is tested
Course creation flow is tested
AI course generation flow is tested where practical
Course editing flow is tested
Learning/study flow is tested
Video/content flow is tested where practical

Tests can be executed reliably

userStories.title: Run full application audit and fix critical issues
userStories.description: Perform a final end-to-end audit of the entire application after the redesign. Identify remaining functional, UI, API, responsive, and integration problems and fix all critical issues discovered.
acceptanceCriteria: All major user journeys are executed end-to-end
All known API integrations have final documented status
Critical console errors are investigated
Critical network/API failures are investigated
Critical UI bugs are fixed

Critical authentication issues are fixed
Critical course-maker issues are fixed
Critical learning issues are fixed
Critical LaTeX issues are fixed
Regression testing is performed after fixes

userStories.title: Final production readiness verification
userStories.description: Perform the final verification required to declare the LEAP modernization complete. Verify that the project satisfies the PRD, documentation is current, tests pass, and no critical known issues remain.
acceptanceCriteria: All previous PRD stories have passes=true
Every discovered API has been tested and documented
Required API integrations work
The complete UI has undergone five substantive redesign/rework passes
Course maker experience is modern and functional
Learning/study experience is modern and functional
LaTeX renderer is fixed and verified
Critical E2E flows pass
Typecheck passes
Lint passes where configured
Relevant tests pass
